app.title: GPU-unlock: FP/BF16 instruction issue rate on Nvidia 3000's cards
app.author: fragebogen
app.description: A command‑line utility that measures and reports the instruction issue rates for FP32 and BF16 operations on NVIDIA RTX 30‑series GPUs, helping developers understand performance bottlenecks.
proposed_tests: Clone the repository and install dependencies with pip install -e .
Run `gpu-unlock --help` and verify the help output is displayed.
Execute `gpu-unlock --benchmark` on an RTX 3070 and capture the reported issue rates.
Compare the reported FP32 issue rate against a baseline obtained from Nsight Compute to ensure consistency within ±5%.
